slides.title: Ex-fighters register to return to civilian life
Hundreds have signed up
slides.body: Africanews, citing AFP, reported hundreds of former fighters registering at a monument in Mekelle since Wednesday, October 14.

slides.title: Part of the 2022 Pretoria deal
slides.body: The reintegration effort comes under the disarmament and demobilisation provisions of the peace agreement that ended the 2020-2022 war.

slides.title: What is not yet known
slides.body: No official count was given, and the report did not name who runs the programme. Not independently verified.

slides.title: Protect civilians. Support dialogue.
slides.body: Follow for sourced updates from across Ethiopia.

source: Source: Africanews with AFP, "Ex-fighters in Ethiopia's Tigray region register for reintegration programme" · Oct 17, 2026

card.title: Ex-fighters register in Mekelle
card.body: Hundreds sign up for a reintegration programme, Africanews reported.
